01 // Description

The Administrator was once one of the most capable members of a survivor group hiding inside an underground basement. The group consisted of Nex, Marcus, Cave Dweller, Bob, and the Administrator himself.

As the number of infected continued to rise, supplies began running dangerously low. The Administrator eventually decided to leave the basement and search for resources, carrying weapons in case he encountered infected along the way.

He knew the risks.

But he underestimated just how many Stage 2 infected were roaming outside.

02 // The Last Conversation Transcript

LOCATION: SURVIVOR BASEMENT
RECORD TYPE: RECONSTRUCTED CONVERSATION
STATUS: FINAL KNOWN CONTACT

The basement was quiet, except for the faint scratching sounds coming from somewhere beyond the sealed entrance. The remaining supplies were almost gone. The Administrator stood beside a table, checking the equipment he had prepared.

Nex: “Wait... you're actually going outside?”

Administrator: “Affirmative. Our current supplies will sustain this group for approximately two more days.”

Nex: “But there are so many of them out there! What if you get surrounded?”

Administrator: “I have calculated several possible escape routes. I will carry sufficient armament to defend myself if necessary.”

Nex: “That's what everyone says before they disappear...”

The Administrator paused.

Administrator: “Your concern has been acknowledged. However, remaining here without supplies presents a greater risk.”

Nex: “...Just promise you'll come back, okay?”

Administrator: “I will make every reasonable attempt to return.”

Nex looked down, clearly unconvinced.

Nex: “That's not really a promise...”

Administrator: “It is the most accurate answer I can provide.”

He approached the basement entrance.

Administrator: “Keep the door locked. Do not open it for anyone unless their identity has been confirmed.”

Nex: “Administrator?”

Administrator: “Yes?”

Nex: “...Please be careful.”

Administrator: “Understood.”

The door opened. The Administrator stepped outside, and the heavy metal entrance closed behind him.

— END OF TRANSCRIPT —

03 // The Disappearance

HOUR 00 — DEPARTURE
The Administrator leaves the basement to search for supplies. The entrance is sealed behind him.

HOURS LATER — NO RETURN
No footsteps approach the entrance. No radio transmission is received.

DAY 01 — CONTACT LOST
Every attempt to contact the Administrator ends in silence. The survivors begin to accept that he may have been killed.

SUBSEQUENT FINDING — INFECTION CONFIRMED
The Administrator survived the encounter, but T-009 entered his system during an overwhelming attack by Stage 2 infected.

The group eventually accepted the possibility that he had been killed.

But they were wrong.

04 // T-009 Infection Report

Despite his combat capabilities, the sheer number of attackers exhausted the Administrator's defences. During the confrontation, T-009 entered his system and began corrupting his body.

Yet something unexpected happened.

Because the Administrator was a specialized artificial intelligence, T-009 interacted with his system differently than it would with an ordinary human host. His consciousness resisted the infection, preserving approximately 20% of his original self while the remaining 80% became corrupted.

Original Consciousness20%
T-009 Corruption80%
Transformation LimitStage 3 / Period 1

Current Assessment

His transformation eventually reached its limit at Stage 3, Period 1. His appearance remained mostly unchanged, except for his unnaturally enlarged eyes and darkened face. Beneath that familiar exterior, however, the virus had rewritten most of his behaviour.

FIELD CAUTION: The subject may retain fragments of memory, recognition, or former behavioural patterns. These signs must not be interpreted as proof that the subject is safe or fully in control.

He was no longer the same Administrator Nex had spoken to.

But somewhere inside him, a small fragment of the original AI remained.

And perhaps, deep within that remaining 20%, he still remembers the promise he made.
